reviews.text: I really love this gel cream! The texture is lightweight, fresh and cooling, which makes it perfect for everyday use. It absorbs quickly and leaves my skin feeling hydrated, soft and comfortable without any greasy feeling. I also love the K-pop Demon Hunters packaging — such a cute bonus! Definitely a moisturizer I enjoy using.
reviews.zh: 我真係好鍾意呢款凝膠面霜！質地輕盈、清新、帶清涼感，啱晒日常使用。吸收快，用咗之後皮膚感覺水潤、柔軟、舒服，冇油膩感。我仲好鍾意 K-pop Demon Hunters 嘅包裝，好可愛嘅額外驚喜！絕對係一款我好享受用嘅保濕霜。

reviews.text:
I’ve been using this product for a few weeks and I’m really happy with the results. My skin feels softer, smoother, and much more hydrated. It absorbs nicely without feeling heavy or sticky. Definitely worth trying!

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Love
reviews.zh:
我用咗呢款產品幾個星期，對效果好滿意。皮膚感覺更加柔軟、更加順滑，保濕效果好多。吸收得好好，唔會覺得太厚重或者黏。絕對值得一試！

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ 好鍾意

reviews.text: Questa è proprio la tipologia di crema che amo per la pelle mista. Ha una consistenza fresca e leggera, si assorbe facilmente e non lascia il viso appesantito. Allo stesso tempo, però, lascia la pelle morbida e ben idratata. La trovo perfetta soprattutto quando voglio una skincare semplice e non voglio sentirmi il viso pieno di prodotto. Secondo me è particolarmente comoda anche al mattino.
reviews.zh: 呢款正正係我最鍾意、啱我混合性皮膚嘅面霜類型。質地清新輕盈，容易吸收，唔會令面部覺得沉重。同時，皮膚會保持柔軟、水分充足。我覺得佢特別好，尤其係當我想簡單護膚、唔想覺得面上塞滿產品嗰時。我認為朝早用都特別方便。

reviews.text: I love this gel cream, especially for summer. And love it even more because it is safe for kids to use. I have made multiple orders of this cream just because it is so light yet so effective. The ingredients are also amazing for healing the skin barrier and working towards glass skin. Highly recommend
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意呢款凝膠面霜，特別係夏天。仲令我更加鍾意，因為小朋友都可以用。我因為佢咁輕盈又咁有效，已經落過多次單。成份都好好，有助修復皮膚屏障，並朝「玻璃肌」目標邁進。強烈推薦

reviews.text: I really like this moisturiser for my acne prone skin (combination-oily dehydrated at times). it's a very lightweight gel that absorbs well and hasn't clogged my pores nor has it made me break out so far. However, I've used it less than a week so I can't say that it won't happen. The cream does spread well so you don't need to use a lot of it
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意呢款保濕霜，我嘅皮膚易生暗瘡（混合偏油，有時會缺水）。佢係一款好輕盈嘅凝膠，吸收得好，到目前為止未有堵塞毛孔，亦都未有令我爆痘。不過，我只係用咗唔夠一個星期，所以唔可以話一定唔會發生。面霜推開得好，所以唔需要用好多。

reviews.text: A lightweight gel cream that gives the skin a refreshing dose of hydration while helping support the skin barrier. It feels soothing and comfortable without being heavy or greasy, making it great for sensitive or dehydrated skin. Leaves the skin soft, hydrated, and healthier-looking
reviews.zh: 一款輕盈嘅凝膠面霜，為皮膚帶嚟清爽嘅水分補充，同時有助支持皮膚屏障。塗落去感覺舒緩、舒服，唔會厚重或者油膩，好啱敏感或者缺水嘅皮膚。令皮膚柔軟、水潤，睇落更健康。

reviews.text: J'utilise cette crème depuis trois semaines et le résultat est incroyable. Ma peau est beaucoup plus douce, souple et lumineuse au réveil. Sa texture légère fond instantanément sur le visage et procure un confort immédiat qui dure toute la journée. De plus, son parfum délicat rend l'application très agréable. C'est un vrai coup de cœur pour ma routine beauté quotidienne. Je la recommande vivement à toutes les personnes qui cherchent un soin nourrissant et efficace.
reviews.zh: 我用呢款面霜三個星期，效果真係好好。起床之後，皮膚變得更加柔軟、有彈性、光亮。質地輕盈，即刻喺面上溶化，帶嚟嘅舒適感可以持續成日。另外，佢嘅香味幽雅，令塗抹過程好舒服。佢真係令我好鍾意，成為我日常護膚嘅心頭好。我非常推薦畀所有想搵一款滋養又有效嘅護膚品嘅人。

reviews.text: Very good moisturiser for sensitive oily and combo acne prone skin. Especially ones using retinoids. Very lightweight and absorbs into skin nicely. Will leave your skin feeling buttery smooth. You won’t wake up feeling oily at all
reviews.zh: 非常好嘅保濕霜，適合敏感、油性同混合性、易生暗瘡嘅皮膚。尤其係用緊維 A 類成分嘅人。質地好輕盈，吸收得好。會令皮膚摸落滑得似牛油咁。你早上醒嚟完全唔會覺得油。

note: 以下評價由 YesStyle 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
